data.title: Apartment assignment and usage contract (Nutzungsvertrag) for Lindenhof 6
data.summary: Wohnungsgenossenschaft Beispielheim eG assigned Mr Musterschmidt the apartment Lindenhof 6 (2nd floor left) starting 1 September 2025 and encloses the usage contract (Nutzungsvertrag) and house rules (Hausordnung) in two copies, asking him to sign and return one copy within the deadline shown.
data.explanation: Your housing cooperative confirms that the board has allocated you the apartment at Lindenhof 6 and sends you the usage contract (Nutzungsvertrag) and house rules for your signature. Sign one copy and send it back by the deadline shown, which is counted in working days (Monday to Saturday, excluding Sundays and public holidays) starting from the date of this letter. If the signed contract does not reach the cooperative in time, they will offer the apartment to the next member on the waiting list instead, so don't delay returning it. Keep the second copy for yourself.
